retrieval_policy.current_unit_rule: The kickoff must remain completable using only the three local learner-safe documents and Python 3's standard library.
retrieval_policy.locator_rule: A catalog URL or citation is a locator, not evidence that content is available, current, licensed, safe, or an official unit.
later_job_requirements: Use an explicitly authorized retrieval job and fetch only public or otherwise lawfully accessible material
Record the final locator, source identity, offering/version, retrieval time, checksum when applicable, rights information, and validation label
Inspect content before exposing it to learners and classify each item as a resource, official unit, assignment brief, tool, or unrelated pointer
Keep source repositories read-only and copy only approved artifacts into per-attempt workspaces
Recompute unit dependencies only after availability has been validated
never_retrieve_or_expose: Paywalled, access-controlled, or copyrighted full text without authorization
